---
title: "A Report for One Department"
engine: knitr
params:
  department: "Sales"
  month: "Jan"
format:
  html:
    toc: true
execute:
  echo: true
---

## Choose a report variant

The YAML header defines defaults. Override them at render time, for example:

```bash
quarto render 08-parameterized-report.qmd -P department:Support -P month:Feb --output support-feb.html
```

Parameters select a subset of this fictional dataset. They do not change the
page interactively; render again to create another variant.

```{r}
#| label: select-department
records <- data.frame(
  department = rep(c("Sales", "Support"), each = 3),
  month = rep(c("Jan", "Feb", "Mar"), times = 2),
  completed = c(120, 135, 128, 90, 105, 115),
  target = c(110, 120, 130, 100, 100, 110)
)

if (!params$department %in% records$department) {
  stop("Unknown department. Choose Sales or Support.")
}
if (!params$month %in% records$month) {
  stop("Unknown month. Choose Jan, Feb, or Mar.")
}
selected <- subset(records,
  department == params$department & month == params$month)
```

## Selected results

Department: **`r params$department`**. Month: **`r params$month`**.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-selected
#| tbl-cap: "Selected fictional results"
knitr::kable(selected, row.names = FALSE)
```

The team completed **`r selected$completed`** items against a target of
**`r selected$target`**, reaching
**`r round(100 * selected$completed / selected$target, 1)`%** of the target.

## Parameters from a file

The companion `08-report-params.yml` selects Support in February:

```bash
quarto render 08-parameterized-report.qmd --execute-params 08-report-params.yml --output support-feb.html
```

Use distinct output filenames to keep multiple variants. This example needs
only the R rendering packages already used by `04-r-analysis.qmd`.
